snippet.title: you can earn pp
snippet.description:
osu! is about to undergo an agricultural revolution as players begin farming pp in lazer. if you don't want to be a cave dweller anymore, it's time to try lazer for yourself: https://osu.ppy.sh/home/download

by the way. you can earn pp in lazer now.

listen to peppy (the lead developer of osu!) and pishifat (qualifications pending) talk about the current caveats of pp in lazer and the rest of lazer's recent updates.
